reasons.plausibility: CNTs degrade above ~500°C in air and are unstable under neutron irradiation, making them unsuitable for 1000°C fusion-reactor conditions, and their high interfacial thermal resistance with metals often negates bulk conductivity gains.
reasons.testability: The proposed comparative test of thermal conductivity, tensile strength, and swelling under controlled irradiation is clear and would decisively falsify the hypothesis if the CNT composite fails to outperform the baseline.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it ignores well-known CNT stability limits in high-temperature, high-irradiation environments, so testing it would waste resources on a fundamentally flawed concept.
